Cardiac rehabilitation.Recommendation: All ACS patients should participate in a medically supervised, structured, comprehensive, multidisciplinary exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation and prevention programme.

Lifestyle management.Recommendation: ACS patients should adopt a healthy lifestyle, including stopping all smoking of tobacco; healthy diet (Mediterranean style); alcohol restriction; regular aerobic physical activity and resistance exercise; reduced sedentary time.

Smoking cessation in smokers.Recommendation: Offering follow-up support, nicotine replacement therapy, varenicline or bupropion, individually or in combination, should be considered.

High-dose statin.Recommendation: High-dose statin therapy is recommended to be initiated or continued as early as possible, regardless of initial LDL-C values.

LDL-C target.Recommendation: Aim to achieve an LDL-C level of <1.4 mmol/L (<55 mg/dL) and to reduce LDL-C by ≥50% from baseline.

Add ezetimibe.Recommendation: If LDL-C goal is not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin therapy after 4–6 weeks, the addition of ezetimibe is recommended.

Add PCSK9 inhibitor.Recommendation: If the LDL-C goal is not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin therapy and ezetimibe after 4–6 weeks, the addition of a PCSK9 inhibitor is recommended.

Intensify lipid-lowering therapy during.Recommendation: It is recommended to intensify lipid-lowering therapy during the index ACS hospitalization for patients who were on lipid-lowering therapy before admission.

Associated Conditions: Elevated LDL-C despite maximally tolerated statin and ezetimibe
